name: Stormwind Armor Marker
summary: Stormwind Armor Marker lets those who aid the realm claim crafted gear from sanctioned artisans. Sara Timberlain accepts one at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

sections.title: Military Requisitions
sections.body: Stormwind's commanders issue armor markers to those who serve the realm. Keeping law and order across Elwynn Forest stretches Stormwind's resources thin, so commanders sometimes use these official requisition slips instead of handing out standard gear at military outposts. A marker confirms the bearer's service and authorizes local craftsmen under contract to provide tailored armor.

sections.title: Eastvale Provisioning
sections.body: At the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain and other artisans work under commission from the Stormwind Army. The camp lies on Elwynn's eastern frontier, where they use local materials to make protective cloth and leather garments. Present a marker there to receive custom-fitted defense for guarding the surrounding woodlands.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Stormwind Armor Marker?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Armor Marker is an official military voucher for those who aid Stormwind's guards. It proves your service and lets you claim protective armor from an artisan under contract with the army.

Sara Timberlain accepts the marker at the Eastvale Logging Camp, just east across the river in Elwynn Forest. She is under contract with the Stormwind Army to provide tailored cloth and leather equipment.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind use markers instead of handing out armor directly?
faq.answer: Stormwind uses markers because outlying guard posts may lack the storage, blacksmithing or tailoring setups to outfit recruits on site. Field commanders can send recruits to local artisans like Sara Timberlain, who have dedicated workshops.

faq.q: What kind of equipment does the marker provide?
faq.answer: The marker lets its bearer choose a newly crafted cloth or leather armor piece made to order by an army supplier under contract.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see how Eastvale Logging Camp connects frontier settlements to Stormwind's military command.
